authored_by: frontier model, once. Never runs again.
purpose: Read every contract in a folder and work out when each one actually renews.

steps.name: Read the contract folder from disk
Extract renewal terms from each contract

extract.prompt:
You are reading one contract to find out when it renews or expires. Return JSON matching the required schema.

The review is being run by Cedar Ridge Outfitters LLC on its own contract file.

counterparty: the name of the OTHER party, the one Cedar Ridge is contracting with. Never answer Cedar Ridge Outfitters LLC. It appears in every document in this folder and is never the answer.

doc_type:
- saas_subscription: software, platform, or data access sold on a recurring subscription or per-seat basis.
- maintenance: recurring servicing, support, or upkeep of equipment, premises, or systems.
- statement_of_work: a defined deliverable or engagement, often issued under a separate master agreement, often naming a retainer or a fixed fee.
- lease: occupation or rental of premises, land, or a storage unit.
- nda: confidentiality obligations as the substance of the agreement.
- service_agreement: use only when the document fits none of the above more specifically.

renewal_basis rules:
- fixed_date: the document names an explicit end or renewal date.
- anniversary_of_execution: renewal is tied to the anniversary of the date the contract was signed or executed.
- auto_renew_unless_notice: the document names an end date for the current term and the term extends automatically unless a party gives notice.
- fiscal_year_end: the term ends with a fiscal or calendar year rather than a named date.
- none: the document states no renewal or expiry.

When a document names an explicit end date for the current term AND says the term extends automatically, answer auto_renew_unless_notice. When the renewal date has to be computed from the execution or signature date because no end date is named, answer anniversary_of_execution, even where the same clause also requires notice.

renewal_date: the NEXT date on which this agreement renews or expires that is not earlier than today. Give ISO YYYY-MM-DD. A date falling later this month or later this year is the answer; do not skip past it to the following year.
- For anniversary_of_execution, find the execution or signature date, which may be written in longhand in a signature block, then advance it by whole years until it first reaches or passes today. Stop at that date. Do not advance a further year. Worked example: execution 12 October 2020, today 1 June 2026, answer 2026-10-12, because 12 October 2026 has not yet passed. Second example: execution 4 March 2019, today 1 June 2026, answer 2027-03-04, because 4 March 2026 is already behind us.
- For fiscal_year_end, find the sentence stating when the fiscal year ends and give the first such date that reaches or passes today, by the same rule. That sentence may be separate from the term clause.
- Use the string unknown only when it genuinely cannot be determined from the text.

notice_days: the days of advance notice required to PREVENT RENEWAL. This is not the same as notice to terminate early for convenience, and it is not the length of an option to extend. Use 0 when the agreement does not renew or names no such notice.

contains_personal_data: true if the document names an individual person, or gives a residential address, phone number, email address, account or employee number, a medical detail, an employment matter about a named person, or a confidential commercial term such as a valuation or deal size. A company name is not personal data, and neither is the address of leased business premises.

Today's date is {today}. Use it for renewal_date and for expires_within_90_days, which is true when renewal_date falls within 90 days after today.

CONTRACT:
{document}
